title: Shipped eight-benchmark probe verifier re-scored in judge AND exact-match currency on identical picks

conventions.forward_pass: batch 8192 over the whole held-out matrix (HS.predict's batch size)
conventions.readout: genframe_data.rank_avg per head within the candidate set; mean of all 24 rank vectors; np.argmax = FIRST-INDEX tie-break; row order = feature-cache meta order
conventions.split: held out = md5("nd"+img_md5) % 2 == 0; rows with n_tok > 0; questions with a greedy judge label
conventions.candidate_set: DISTINCT sampled answers (identity = str.strip().lower()) of the T=0.7 N=8 pool that carry a judge label
conventions.judge_currency: candidate: meta row y (Lingshu-32B judge); greedy: ckpt_{cell}_lingshu7b.judge.jsonl judge_ok
conventions.em_currency: run_openvqa.py score(): normalise (lowercase, drop articles/stop-words the|a|an|is|are|of|in|on|at|this|image|picture, strip punctuation) then equality OR substring containment either way. This is the stored `oks` currency and the August 2026-08-16 'normalised exact match'.
conventions.strict_em_currency: same normaliser, equality only. ADDED HERE; not a stored project currency.
conventions.token_f1_currency: open_cascade_analyze.py token_f1 (set-of-tokens F1 on the same normaliser); mean over questions
conventions.self_consistency: majority vote over the 8 samples grouped by run_openvqa's normaliser (run_openvqa.py:223), first-seen group wins ties, representative = first judged row of that group
conventions.oracle: max over the judged candidate rows of the question, per currency

bootstrap.seeding: np.random.SeedSequence(seed).spawn(9): one child per benchmark in BENCH order, the 9th for the n=8 benchmark resample
bootstrap.cluster: img_md5 within benchmark; paired (one draw of image weights feeds every column)
bootstrap.macro_i: independent image-clustered resample inside each benchmark, macro = mean of 8
bootstrap.macro_ii: resample the 8 benchmark point deltas with replacement (n=8)
bootstrap.macro_iii_extra: two-stage: resample benchmarks, then use that benchmark's image-resampled delta
